rules: Designed 2026-10-21 and parked: written as if starting from high school, with your real entry point in entry_points.
No pretests (your call, 2026-10-08, kept for later majors): credited courses count from your degrees; 'maybe' courses are yours to skim or skip; you look things up when a gap shows.
A course shared with another major (same id) is one course: finishing it anywhere counts everywhere.

entry_points.basis: High-school Spanish (2026-10-21): the first semester is 'maybe'. A short pretest at the start of SP102 decides whether to go back.
